label: TURN-64
summary: Dual bugfix: (1) Disability screening heuristic gate added. (2) Senior-role over-matching tightened via config-driven experience gap and raised match_threshold.

fix_A_disability_gate.root_cause: No disability/PWD keyword handler existed. Final blind fallback `if options: return options[0]` selected 'I have a disability' because it was options[0] in the chatbot list. Triggered on a live Naukri chatbot application.
fix_A_disability_gate.fix: Inserted explicit disability/PWD detector before section 7 (Boolean fallback) and section 8 (options[0] safe default). Reads cand.get('has_disability', False). Field absent in config = False = No disability. Three-tier matching: (1) explicit no-disability markers, (2) option without 'have a disability'/'yes', (3) options[-1] as last resort. Numeric fields return '0'.
fix_A_disability_gate.user_directive: AG brain should select NO for health/identity questions not answerable from profile with certainty.

fix_B_config_threshold.rationale: match_threshold 40 allowed borderline keyword-overlap matches (CFO, Finance Manager, Regional Commercial Manager 12-15 yrs) to get applied. Raised to 65 aligns with ENTRY #002 60% cutoff with small buffer. max_experience_gap_years:2 exposes configurable band for Fix C.

fix_C_experience_gap.root_cause: Hardcoded cand_exp+3 tolerance. For fresher (cand_exp=0.5), this allowed roles requiring up to 3.5 years through Stage 1 hard gate. Combined with 40% match_threshold, CFO/Finance Manager/Senior Accountant all received APPLIED status.
fix_C_experience_gap.fix: Replaced with dynamic _max_gap from config target_jobs.max_experience_gap_years (default 2). For Anshika: hard-reject threshold now 2.5 years. Roles requiring more than 2.5 years are rejected at Stage 1 with zero score.

details.purity_check: Pure: True [] -- confirmed after all edits
details.candidate_context: Fresher, 0.5 years total experience. B.Com Hons Hansraj. Internships in Finance/Marketing/Campus. Target: Internal Auditor, Financial Analyst, Audit Associate, FP&A Analyst etc.
